habit_scope: Brick/stone veneer on a ledge with a cavity and ties. CMHC Ch13. Alt — needs a foundation ledge (permit-gate). Not the wood-siding habit. AF&PA also names masonry veneer over wood framing.
how_it_is_done: Foundation must include a supporting ledge or offset with ≥25 mm (1 in) space between masonry and sheathing membrane (CMHC Fig 113). ICF flare is a named support alt (Fig 114).
Base flashing from the outside face over the ledge and ≥150 mm (6 in) up the wall behind the sheathing paper.

Corrosion-resistant metal ties nailed to the studs and embedded in mortar joints. Spacing: every other stud → 800 mm (32 in) horiz × 400 mm (16 in) vert; OR every stud → 600 mm (24 in) horiz × 500 mm (20 in) vert, or 400 mm (16 in) horiz × 600 mm (24 in) vert, depending on stud spacing.

Full mortar bed. Do not drop mortar into the cavity. Tool outside joints smooth. Weep holes ≤800 mm (32 in) apart in the bottom course and above-grade windows and doors (omit mortar in the head joint or insert tubes).
Veneer ≥75 mm (2-3/4 in) thick; <90 mm (3-1/2 in) must have unraked joints. Cold weather: protect from freezing; masonry and mortar >5°C (41°F) for ≥24 h.
AF&PA: masonry veneer over wood framing; 1 in space on PWF; base flashing from outside of masonry to 8 in min up the wall, behind the sheathing paper, over the building paper. Confirm AHJ.
Permit-gate: ledge on the foundation. Late swap from siding is a foundation change.
tools_equipment: Named: ties; flashing; weeps. Not a SKU list.
inspection_hold_points: Base flashing 6 in up behind paper.
material_classes: weep tubes or open head joints
when_this_beats_habit: When drawings/foundation have a ledge. Not the first-touch siding habit.
when_this_is_a_bad_idea: No ledge. Mortar-clogged cavity. Skipping weeps. Swapping after the foundation is poured.
why_tier1_never_learned_it: Ties and weeps and the ledge. Not a siding substitute after the pour.
permit_gate: must be on drawings before permit
permit_gate_notes: Ledge/offset on the foundation. Confirm AHJ. CMHC Canadian.
risk_if_swapped_late: Siding to brick after the foundation is poured needs a ledge that is not there. Catch before permit.
plain_language_summary: Brick on a ledge, one inch of air, ties into the studs, flashing up the wall, weeps every 32 inches. This is an alt. If the foundation has no ledge, this is not a field save.
spanish_summary: Ladrillo sobre un ledge, una pulgada de aire, amarres a los studs, flashing subiendo, lloraderos cada 32 pulgadas. Alternativa. Sin ledge en la cimentacion no es un ahorro de campo.
locators: CMHC Ch13 Masonry Veneer; Fig 113; tie spacing; weeps 32 in
AF&PA Masonry Veneer — 1 in space, base flashing 8 in up
confidence_notes: Tie spacing and weeps printed. Ledge is permit-gate. Canadian + AF&PA US 8 in flashing.

fastener_schedule.size: corrosion-resistant metal ties nailed to studs (nail penny not printed)
fastener_schedule.pattern: every other stud: 32 in horiz × 16 in vert; OR every stud: 24 in × 20 in or 16 in × 24 in

certs: Confirm with AHJ / engineer. CMHC is Canadian NBC — not IRC.
labor.named_not_headcount: Books name trades, not a headcount.

layering: Base flashing over ledge and 6 in up behind paper (CMHC); AF&PA 8 in up.
Weeps ≤32 in at bottom and over openings.
Keep mortar out of the cavity.
code_to_check: AHJ veneer/ties. CMHC NBC. AF&PA 8 in flashing. Do not invent IRC.
time_money: No dollars. Ledge is not a field save.

walkthroughs.what_it_shows: Field house full-bed brick. Ties into studs ~1 ft; wrap; window flashing + weep rope. 2-story inferred from cantilever, not counted. Book weeps/ties disagree (AF&PA vs CMHC) — keep both, confirm AHJ. Thin brick FLAG — do not flip. Hunt cw-P11-2026-08-30.
